assertions.text: Skill correctly parses --lang vi flag from user input
Skill confirms output language is Vietnamese (vi)
Skill routes to correct workflow (task workflow for feature/task/story)
All output written in Vietnamese with full diacritics (tiếng Việt có dấu)
Technical terms and code identifiers remain untranslated
--vi shorthand also works and is equivalent to --lang vi
When both --vi and --lang present, --lang takes precedence
